films.name: Camel
markers: hump on the back
long curving neck held high
very long knobbly-kneed legs
films.note: Generic name read as a representative dromedary. Taller than most people draw: the leg mass is roughly half the total height.

films.name: Pilot Whale
markers: bulbous melon forehead overhanging the mouth
long low swept-back dorsal fin set well forward on the back
black body with a pale anchor patch on the throat

films.name: Manatee
markers: rounded spatula paddle tail
blunt bristly downturned muzzle with a split upper lip
barrel body with front flippers and no hind limbs

films.name: River Dolphin
markers: very long narrow tweezer beak crowded with teeth
low ridge or hump instead of a tall dorsal fin
bulging flexible melon and a mobile neck

films.name: Ladybug
markers: strongly domed hemispherical shell
spotted red wing cases split down the middle
tiny black head tucked under a shield
films.note: Almost always drawn from above; in true side profile it is a low dome and the spots barely read, so the silhouette must carry the arc of the shell.

films.name: Hoatzin
markers: spiky rufous punk crest
bare blue face with a staring red eye
long broad tail and heavy chest over a slim neck

films.name: Kakapo
markers: moss-green plumage mottled with black and yellow
owl-like whiskered facial disc
heavy squat flightless parrot body

films.name: Tern
markers: deeply forked tail streamers
long narrow pointed wings
slim dagger bill and a black cap over the crown
